course_name_original: Preparation and submission of the diploma thesis
course_name_en: Preparation and submission of the diploma thesis
prerequisites: Obligatory work – applies to students who are graduating and have knowledge of the entire course of studies.

learning_outcomes.text: The purpose of the diploma thesis is to demonstrate the student's ability to plan and execute an independent project (theoretical and model study, construction project, technological project, research and experimental work) in the field of construction and operation of machines

Knows and independently applies the rules for the completion of a diploma thesis of a theoretical and model, construction, technological or experimental nature in the field of construction and operation of machines and devices
learning_outcomes.code: K_WG01, K_WG02, K_WG04, K_WG06, K_WG09, K_WG10, K_WG11, K_WG14, K_WG16, K_WK22

learning_outcomes.text: Is able to plan and perform a diploma thesis of a theoretical and model, construction, technological or experimental nature in the field of construction and operation of machines and devices
He is aware of the need for professional conduct and compliance with the rules of professional ethics

syllabus_topics: The engineering diploma thesis is an independent project of a theoretical and model, construction, technological or experimental nature in the field of construction and operation of machines
teaching_methods: Independent work under the supervision of the supervisor
bibliography: Marciniak J.: Poradnik realizacji prac dyplomowych. WISBIOP w Radomiu, Radom 2004
Pytkowski W.: Organizacja badań i ocena prac naukowych. PWN, Warszawa 1981
Pozostałe pozycje w literaturze są indywidualnie dobierane w zależności od tematu pracy realizowanej przez studenta.
